  "memo":"R03 holds because the IN-issued card was used from a US IP and AVS failed. Card is the only adverse family; no other rule holds. No household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. A legitimate customer using a foreign-issued card is plausible given prior card use, the longstanding device and shipping home, but these facts do not resolve cardholder identity. Under FP-2 §6.6(b), recommend needs_check, implemented as a hold for id_check before shipment. No checks have run; decline is not permitted with only this family. Issuer authentication and identity verification are the cheapest applicable next check."
